description: Creates a `{ current: null }` ref object. Use it in class fields; in function components use `useRef`, because `createRef` returns a new object every render.
Pre-React 19 wrapper that lets a function component receive a `ref` as a second argument. Still works, but no longer necessary.
React 19 passes `ref` to function components in props: `function Input({ ref })`.
A ref on a class component element points to the instance, so the parent can call its methods.
